    {
      "step": 1,
      "text": "WASH {{ing_01|the fowl}} AND DRESS IT NICELY."
    },
    {
      "step": 2,
      "text": "PUT {{ing_01|them}} IN A STEW POT, ADD {{ing_02|water}}, {{ing_03|salt}} AND {{ing_04|dill}}, PARBOIL SO AS TO HAVE {{ing_01|them}} HALF DONE, UNTIL THE MEAT IS HARD, REMOVE {{ing_01|them}}, PUT {{ing_01|them}} IN A SAUCE PAN WITH {{ing_05|oil}}, {{ing_06|broth}}, {{ing_07|a bunch of origany}} AND {{ing_08|coriander}}."
    },
    {
      "step": 3,
      "text": "WHEN NEARLY DONE, ADD {{ing_09|a little reduced must}}, TO GIVE IT COLOR."
    },
    {
      "step": 4,
      "text": "MEANWHILE CRUSH {{ing_10|pepper}}, {{ing_11|lovage}}, {{ing_12|cumin}}, {{ing_08|coriander}}, {{ing_13|laser root}}, {{ing_14|rue}} moistened with {{ing_15|reduced wine}} AND SOME {{ing_16|honey}}, ADD SOME OF THE {{ing_17|fowl broth}} TO IT AND {{ing_18|vinegar}} TO TASTE; EMPTY THE SAUCE INTO A SAUCE PAN, HEAT, BIND WITH {{ing_19|roux}}, AND STRAIN THE SAUCE OVER {{ing_01|the fowl}} IN AN ENTRÉE DISH."
